title: Mobility polish: silent cap-break time drop, jitter/center skew, ULP idle churn, degenerate-bounds ping-pong, RPGM unbounded members
description: P3 batch from 3x codereview of uory fix (mobility.py): (1) All four step() loops drop leftover sim time on the 100k-iteration cap break silently - docstrings still promise 'advance position by dt_us'; add a debug log/counter and document the cap in docstrings. (2) On cap break GroupMobility._update_jitter(dt_us) still advances jitter by FULL dt while center movement was truncated - minor clock skew between jitter glide and center motion; consider passing consumed time instead. (3) ULP absorption: when charge < ulp(remaining)/2 the subtraction is a no-op and all 100k iterations are idle churn (e.g. legs ~1e-8us with dt=1e12) - a 'remaining did not decrease -> break' check would exit in 1 iteration. (4) RandomWaypoint with degenerate bounds (min>=max, currently unvalidated) ping-pongs waypoint picks at the same point for 100k idle iterations every step; Group/RPGM strict '>' also allows 2*inset == width -> uniform(a,a) degeneracy. (5) RPGM.add_member has no group_size cap (GroupMobility does) - unbounded member list growth.
acceptance_criteria: each sub-item addressed or explicitly waived with rationale; existing sim tests stay green
